description: A lantern with shutters that can be opened or closed to control the light.
name: Lantern hooded
notes: Light it with a tinderbox: a flask of oil burns 6 hours.
Hold it lit in your off hand: night fights outdoors without the darkness penalty (no need with darkvision).
Close its shutter to hide the light without putting it out: it burns on, and nothing sees you coming (but you're in the dark).
At night in the wild a lit light gives you away: whatever might ambush you sees you coming (−5 Stealth).
Put it out to save the oil; refill it with a flask of oil when it runs dry.
